title: Ask for the help you actually need

practice.meaning: I need time.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào shíjiān.

transfer.meaning: I need help.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào bāngzhù.

scene: You have enough time, but you are stuck on a task. Ask your colleague for help.
explanation: 我 means “I”. 需要 means “need”. Put what you need after 我需要.

closing.meaning: Sure, I will help you.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ lái bāng nǐ.

incomingNote: 需要帮助吗？ reuses “need help”. 吗 turns it into a yes/no question. Answer with what you need.

title: Set an expectation for your reply

practice.meaning: I will reply today.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān huífù nǐ.

transfer.meaning: I will reply tomorrow.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān huífù nǐ.

scene: You cannot answer today and will reply tomorrow. Tell your colleague when to expect your reply.
explanation: Put the time before 回复: 我明天回复你 means “I’ll reply to you tomorrow”.

closing.meaning: Okay, we will speak tomorrow.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo de, nà míngtiān liánxì.

incomingNote: 什么时候 means “when”. It takes the time position in the question; 明天 fills that position in your answer.

title: Ask for the latest deadline

practice.meaning: What is the latest time I should get it to you?
practice.pinyin: Zuìwǎn jǐdiǎn gěi nǐ?

transfer.meaning: What is the latest day I should get it to you?
transfer.pinyin: Zuìwǎn nǎtiān gěi nǐ?

huahua.meaning: Do you have any other questions?

scene: No due date has been given. Ask which day is the latest you can send the work, rather than asking for a clock time.
explanation: 最晚 means “at the latest”. 几点 asks for a clock time; 哪天 asks for a day.

closing.meaning: Friday at the latest is fine.
closing.pinyin: Zuìwǎn xīngqī wǔ gěi wǒ jiù xíng.

incomingNote: 你还有问题吗？ asks whether you have another question. Your reply can be the deadline question you practised.

title: Sequence your work before helping

practice.meaning: I will reply to the emails first, then help you.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xiān huí yóujiàn, zài bāng nǐ.

transfer.meaning: I will write the report first, then help you.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xiān xiě bàogào, zài bāng nǐ.

scene: You must write the report first. Tell your colleague you will help afterward.
explanation: 先 marks your first task. 再 introduces what you will do afterward.

closing.meaning: Okay, take care of your work first.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, nǐ xiān máng.

incomingNote: 现在能帮我吗？ asks whether you can help now. Your reply explains which task comes first.

title: Raise a specific concern

practice.hanzi: 我有个顾虑，预算可能不够。
practice.meaning: I have one concern: the budget might not be enough.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu gè gùlǜ, yùsuàn kěnéng búgòu.

transfer.hanzi: 我有个顾虑，时间可能不够。
transfer.meaning: I have one concern: we might not have enough time.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu gè gùlǜ, shíjiān kěnéng búgòu.

huahua.hanzi: 你觉得这个计划怎么样？
huahua.meaning: What do you think of this plan?

scene: The budget is sufficient, but the deadline is too close. Raise a concern about time.
explanation: 我有个顾虑 introduces a concern. Name the concern afterward: 时间可能不够 means there may not be enough time.

closing.meaning: Then let us adjust the schedule.
closing.pinyin: Nà wǒmen tiáozhěng yíxià shíjiān.

incomingNote: 你觉得……怎么样？ asks for your view. Raise the specific concern described in your situation.

title: Explain a deadline trade-off

practice.meaning: To finish earlier, we would need more people.
practice.pinyin: Yào tíqián, jiù děi zēngjiā rénshǒu.

transfer.meaning: To finish earlier, we would need to reduce the scope.
transfer.pinyin: Yào tíqián, jiù děi suōxiǎo fànwéi.

scene: The deadline has moved earlier. No extra people are available; explain that the scope would need to shrink.
explanation: 要提前，就得…… connects finishing earlier with what would need to change. 人手 means available staff; 范围 means the scope of the work.

closing.meaning: Okay, then let us reduce the scope first.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, nà jiù xiān suōxiǎo fànwéi.

incomingNote: 能提前完成吗？ asks if the work can be finished earlier. Explain the necessary trade-off.

title: Say whether you understand

practice.meaning: I understand.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ dǒng.

transfer.meaning: I do not understand.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng.

scene: The explanation did not make sense. Let the teacher know.
explanation: 我 means “I”. 懂 means “understand”. Put 不 before 懂 to say “do not understand”.

closing.meaning: I will explain it another way.
closing.pinyin: Wǒ huàn gè fāngshì jiěshì.

incomingNote: 懂吗？ means “Do you understand?” 吗 makes it a yes/no question. Answer with 我懂 or 我不懂.

title: Ask for a repetition in the right form

practice.meaning: Please write it once more.
practice.pinyin: Qǐng zài xiě yí biàn.

transfer.meaning: Please say it once more.
transfer.pinyin: Qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.

huahua.meaning: Would you like me to say it again?
huahua.pinyin: Yào wǒ zài shuō yí biàn ma?

scene: You missed what the teacher said. Ask to hear it again.
explanation: 再 asks for repetition. 一遍 means one complete repetition. 请再说一遍 is “Please say it again”.

closing.meaning: Okay, I will say it again.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zài shuō yí biàn.

incomingNote: 要我再说一遍吗？ asks whether you want the teacher to repeat it. The question reuses 再说一遍 from your reply.

title: Ask for a short extension

practice.meaning: Could I hand it in an hour later?
practice.pinyin: Kěyǐ wǎn yí gè xiǎoshí jiāo ma?

transfer.meaning: Could I hand it in a day later?
transfer.pinyin: Kěyǐ wǎn yì tiān jiāo ma?

huahua.meaning: Can you hand it in tomorrow?

scene: The assignment is due tomorrow, but you need one extra day. Request a day, not an hour.
explanation: 晚 plus a duration says how much later. 晚一天交 means to hand something in one day later.

closing.meaning: Yes, hand it in the day after tomorrow.
closing.pinyin: Kěyǐ, hòu tiān jiāo ba.

incomingNote: 明天能交吗？ asks if you can hand it in tomorrow. Your reply asks for a specific extension.

title: Ask for an example that helps

suffix.meaning: links a description to a noun

practice.meaning: Could you give a simple example?
practice.pinyin: Néng jǔ gè jiǎndān de lìzǐ ma?

transfer.meaning: Could you give a concrete example?
transfer.pinyin: Néng jǔ gè jùtǐ de lìzǐ ma?

scene: The teacher is explaining the order of activities. You understand the general idea, but need a concrete example.
explanation: 举个例子 means “give an example”. 具体 asks for a concrete example; 简单 asks for a simple one.

closing.hanzi: 比如，先吃饭，再学习，就是先后顺序。
closing.meaning: For example, eating first and then studying shows the order of activities.
closing.pinyin: Bǐrú, xiān chī fàn, zài xuéxí, jiù shì xiān hòu shùnxù.

incomingNote: 还有问题吗？ means “Any other questions?” Ask for the kind of example that would help you.

title: Confirm your interpretation

practice.meaning: So you mean it is due tomorrow, right?
practice.pinyin: Yějiùshìshuō, míngtiān jiāo, duì ma?

transfer.meaning: So you mean it is due next week, right?
transfer.pinyin: Yějiùshìshuō, xiàzhōu jiāo, duì ma?

huahua.meaning: The report is due next week.

scene: The teacher has said the report is due next week. Restate that deadline to confirm your interpretation.
explanation: 也就是说 introduces your restatement of what someone said. 对吗？ asks them to confirm it.

closing.meaning: Right, handing it in next week is fine.
closing.pinyin: Duì, xiàzhōu jiāo jiù kěyǐ.

incomingNote: 报告下周交 says the report is due next week. Repeat that day in your confirmation.

title: Qualify an academic conclusion

practice.hanzi: 这个结论完全适用于所有情况。
practice.meaning: This conclusion fully applies to every situation.
practice.pinyin: Zhège jiélùn wánquán shìyòngyú suǒyǒu qíngkuàng.

transfer.hanzi: 这个结论未必适用于所有情况。
transfer.meaning: This conclusion does not necessarily apply to every situation.
transfer.pinyin: Zhège jiélùn wèibì shìyòngyú suǒyǒu qíngkuàng.

huahua.meaning: What do you think of this conclusion?

scene: The evidence supports some cases, but not a universal claim. Explain that the conclusion may not apply everywhere.
explanation: 未必 means “not necessarily”. 适用于 introduces the cases a conclusion applies to.

closing.hanzi: 对，不能把个别情况当成全部。
closing.meaning: Right, individual cases cannot be treated as every case.
closing.pinyin: Duì, bù néng bǎ gèbié qíngkuàng dàng chéng quánbù.

incomingNote: 你怎么看这个结论？ asks for your view of the conclusion. Explain why it may not apply to every case.

title: Express missing someone or home

practice.meaning: I miss you.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nǐ.

transfer.meaning: I miss home.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiā.

scene: You are away from home. Tell a relative that you miss home.
explanation: Here, 想 means “miss”. 我想你 means “I miss you”; 我想家 means “I miss home”.

closing.hanzi: 有空就回来，我们都想你。
closing.meaning: Come home when you can. We all miss you.
closing.pinyin: Yǒukōng jiù huí lái, wǒmen dōu xiǎng nǐ.

incomingNote: 想家吗？ asks whether you miss home. 吗 makes it a yes/no question.

title: Tell family when you will come home

practice.meaning: I am coming home today.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān huí jiā.

transfer.meaning: I am coming home tomorrow.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān huí jiā.

scene: Your return is tomorrow. Let your family know when to expect you.
explanation: 回家 means “go home” or “come home”, depending on the situation. Put the time before 回家.

closing.meaning: Okay, see you tomorrow.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, míngtiān jiàn.

incomingNote: 什么时候 asks “when”. Reply with the day before 回家: 我明天回家.

title: Learn a family cooking skill

practice.meaning: I want to learn to make noodles.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué zuò miàntiáo.

transfer.meaning: I want to learn to make dumplings.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué bāo jiǎozǐ.

huahua.meaning: What dish would you like to learn to make?
huahua.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xué zuò shénme cài?

scene: A relative offers to teach you to cook. Say that you want to learn to make dumplings.
explanation: 学 followed by an action means “learn to do it”. 包饺子 is the usual expression for making dumplings by wrapping them.

closing.meaning: Sure, I will teach you to make dumplings.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ jiào nǐ bāo jiǎozǐ.

incomingNote: 你想学做什么菜？ asks which dish you want to learn to make. Name the dish and action in your answer.

title: Ask about their childhood

practice.hanzi: 你小时候最喜欢吃什么？
practice.meaning: What did you most like eating as a child?
practice.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎoshíhòu zuì xǐhuan chī shénme?

transfer.hanzi: 你小时候最喜欢玩什么？
transfer.meaning: What did you most like playing as a child?
transfer.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎoshíhòu zuì xǐhuan wán shénme?

huahua.meaning: What would you like to talk about today?

scene: You want to hear about a relative's childhood games or play, rather than childhood food. Ask what they liked playing.
explanation: 小时候 sets the childhood time frame. Put 什么 after 吃 or 玩 to ask what the person liked.

closing.meaning: I liked skipping rope most as a child.
closing.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu zuì xǐhuan tiào shéng.

incomingNote: 今天想聊什么？ asks what you want to talk about. Start a conversation by asking the childhood question you practised.

title: Explain why you are quiet

practice.hanzi: 我不是不想聊，只是没时间。
practice.meaning: It is not that I do not want to talk; I just do not have time.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng liáo, zhǐshì méi shíjiān.

transfer.hanzi: 我不是不想聊，只是不知道怎么表达。
transfer.meaning: It is not that I do not want to talk; I just do not know how to express it.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng liáo, zhǐshì bù zhīdào zěnme biǎodá.

huahua.meaning: Why are you not saying anything?

scene: You have time and want to talk, but cannot find the Mandarin words for what you mean. Explain that difficulty.
explanation: 不是不想聊 says that not wanting to talk is not the reason. 只是 introduces the actual reason.

closing.meaning: That is okay. Take your time; I am listening.
closing.pinyin: Méiguānxì, màn màn shuō, wǒ tīng zhe.

incomingNote: 你怎么不说话？ asks why you are quiet. Explain the difficulty described in your situation.

title: Acknowledge care while keeping your choice

practice.hanzi: 我知道你为我好，但我想自己试试。
practice.meaning: I know you want what is best for me, but I want to try it myself.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ wèi wǒ hǎo, dàn wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ shìshì.

transfer.hanzi: 我知道你为我好，但我想自己决定。
transfer.meaning: I know you want what is best for me, but I want to decide for myself.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ wèi wǒ hǎo, dàn wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ juédìng.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

huahua.pinyin: Nǐ jiù tīng wǒ de ba.

scene: A relative wants to decide for you. Acknowledge their care and say you want to make the decision yourself.
explanation: 为我好 means having my best interests at heart. Acknowledge that care, then use 但 to explain your own choice.

closing.meaning: Okay, I respect your decision.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zūnzhòng nǐ de juédìng.

incomingNote: 你就听我的吧 asks you to take the other person’s advice. You can acknowledge their care while keeping your decision.

title: Order a drink by name

practice.meaning: I would like tea.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ yào chá.

transfer.meaning: I would like coffee.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ yào kāfēi.

scene: Your friend asked for coffee. Place their order.
explanation: 我 means “I”. 要 means “want”. 我要咖啡 is a simple way to order coffee.

closing.meaning: Okay, one coffee.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo de, yì bēi kāfēi.

incomingNote: 还是 separates choices: 茶还是咖啡？ means “Tea or coffee?” Choose the drink your friend requested.

title: Specify no ice

practice.meaning: I would like ice, thank you.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ yào bīng, xièxiè.

transfer.meaning: No ice for me, thank you.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ bú yào bīng, xièxiè.

scene: You need your drink without ice. Tell the server that you do not want ice.
explanation: 不要 means “do not want”. Put 冰 after it to ask for no ice. 谢谢 adds “thank you”.

closing.meaning: Okay, no ice.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo de, bù jiā bīng.

incomingNote: 要冰吗？ asks whether you want ice. The question reuses 要 and 冰; 吗 marks a yes/no question.

title: Choose how to pay

practice.meaning: I would like to pay in cash.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng fù xiànjīn.

transfer.meaning: I would like to pay by card.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shuākǎ.

scene: You have no cash with you and want to use a card. Tell the cashier your payment method.
explanation: 付现金 means “pay in cash”. 刷卡 means “pay by card”. Use 我想 before the payment method you want.

closing.meaning: Okay, please use your card.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng shuākǎ.

incomingNote: 现金还是刷卡？ offers two payment methods. 还是 means “or” in this choice question.

title: Ask how long a route will take

practice.meaning: About how long does it take by bus?
practice.pinyin: Zuò gōngjiāochē dàgài yào duōjiǔ?

transfer.meaning: About how long does it take by subway?
transfer.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě dàgài yào duōjiǔ?

huahua.meaning: How are you planning to get there?

scene: You are considering the subway and need to check the journey time before choosing it.
explanation: 坐 plus a transport word names how you travel. 大概 asks for an estimate; 多久 asks how long it takes.

closing.meaning: About twenty minutes.
closing.pinyin: Dàgài èr shífēn zhōng.

incomingNote: 你打算怎么去？ asks how you plan to get there. Ask about the travel time for the route in your situation.

title: Ask for a better room politely

suffix.meaning: links a description to a noun

practice.hanzi: 能不能换一间大一点的房间？
practice.meaning: Could I switch to a slightly larger room?
practice.pinyin: Néngbunéng huàn yì jiān dà yìdiǎn de fángjiān?

transfer.hanzi: 能不能换一间安静一点的房间？
transfer.meaning: Could I switch to a slightly quieter room?
transfer.pinyin: Néngbunéng huàn yì jiān ānjìng yìdiǎn de fángjiān?

scene: The room is large enough, but too noisy. Ask for a quieter room.
explanation: 换一间 asks to switch rooms. 一点 softens the requested difference: 安静一点的房间 is a slightly quieter room.

closing.meaning: Sure, I will help you switch rooms.
closing.pinyin: Kěyǐ, wǒ bāng nǐ huàn yì jiān.

incomingNote: 房间怎么样？ asks how the room is. Explain what you want changed through your request.

title: Request a policy exception

practice.hanzi: 我理解规定，但能不能改期？
practice.meaning: I understand the policy, but could I change the date?
practice.pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě guīdìng, dàn néngbunéng gǎiqī?

transfer.hanzi: 我理解规定，但能不能破例退款？
transfer.meaning: I understand the policy, but could you make an exception and refund me?
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě guīdìng, dàn néngbunéng pòlì tuìkuǎn?

huahua.meaning: Under the policy, it cannot be refunded.

scene: You cannot take the trip or reschedule it. A refund is normally unavailable; ask whether an exception can be made.
explanation: 我理解规定 acknowledges the policy. 但 introduces your request. 破例退款 asks for a refund as an exception.

closing.hanzi: 我帮你问问能不能申请。
closing.meaning: I will check whether you can request that.
closing.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ wèn wèn néngbunéng shēnqǐng.

incomingNote: 按规定不能退款 says refunds are normally unavailable. Ask whether an exception can be made.

title: Share an interest

practice.meaning: I like movies.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan diànyǐng.

transfer.meaning: I like music.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yīnyuè.

scene: You are meeting someone new. Tell them you like music.
explanation: 我 means “I”. 喜欢 means “like”. Put your interest after 我喜欢.

closing.meaning: I like music too.
closing.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan yīnyuè.

incomingNote: 喜欢音乐吗？ asks whether you like music. It reuses 喜欢音乐 and adds the question ending 吗.

title: Describe your Mandarin ability honestly

practice.meaning: I cannot write much Chinese.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ bútài huì xiě zhōngwén.

transfer.meaning: I cannot speak much Mandarin.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ bútài huì shuō zhōngwén.

scene: You want to explain that speaking Mandarin is still difficult for you, rather than claim that you cannot speak any at all.
explanation: 不太 softens the statement about limited ability. 说中文 is speaking Chinese; 写中文 is writing it.

closing.meaning: That is okay. We can take our time talking.
closing.pinyin: Méiguānxì, wǒmen màn màn liáo.

incomingNote: 会说中文吗？ asks about speaking. Choose the reply about that ability.

title: Suggest another time

practice.hanzi: 我今天没空，明天可以吗？
practice.meaning: I am busy today. Would tomorrow work?
practice.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān méikòng, míngtiān kěyǐ ma?

transfer.hanzi: 我今天没空，周末可以吗？
transfer.meaning: I am busy today. Would the weekend work?
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān méikòng, zhōumò kěyǐ ma?

scene: You are busy today and tomorrow, but available at the weekend. Suggest the weekend.
explanation: 没空 means “not free”. After explaining that today does not work, suggest another time with ……可以吗？

closing.meaning: Sure, see you at the weekend.
closing.pinyin: Kěyǐ, zhōumò jiàn.

incomingNote: 今天有空吗？ asks whether you are free today. Your reply explains the conflict and proposes another time.

title: Turn experience into an invitation

practice.meaning: I have not been yet. Have you?
practice.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo, nǐ qù guo ma?

transfer.hanzi: 我还没去过，要不要一起去？
transfer.meaning: I have not been yet. Would you like to go together?
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo, yàobuyào yìqǐ qù?

scene: You are discussing a particular cafe and have not been. Invite Huahua to go with you, rather than asking whether Huahua has been.
explanation: 还没去过 says you have not been yet. 要不要一起去？ turns your answer into an invitation to go together.

closing.meaning: Sure, let us go together.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒmen yìqǐ qù.

incomingNote: 你去过那儿吗？ asks if you have been to the cafe being discussed. 过 asks about previous experience.

title: Respond to reassuring news

practice.hanzi: 听你这么说，我更担心了。
practice.meaning: Hearing that makes me more worried.
practice.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, wǒ gèng dānxīn le.

transfer.hanzi: 听你这么说，我就放心了。
transfer.meaning: Hearing that puts my mind at ease.
transfer.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.

huahua.pinyin: Wǒ dào jiā le, hěn ānquán.

scene: You were worried about your friend getting home. They have confirmed that they are safe; express relief.
explanation: 听你这么说 links your reaction to what the other person said. 放心 means feeling reassured or no longer worried.

closing.meaning: Thank you for caring about me.
closing.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ guānxīn wǒ.

incomingNote: Your friend says they are home and safe. Respond with the feeling that fits that news.

title: Ask for thinking space without rejecting

practice.hanzi: 我不是反对，只是想先问清楚。
practice.meaning: I am not against it; I just want to clarify things first.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì fǎnduì, zhǐshì xiǎng xiān wèn qīngchǔ.

transfer.hanzi: 我不是反对，只是想再考虑一下。
transfer.meaning: I am not against it; I just want to think it over a little more.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì fǎnduì, zhǐshì xiǎng zài kǎolǜ yíxià.

huahua.meaning: Shall we settle on that, then?

scene: You understand the details and are not opposed, but want more time to think before committing.
explanation: 我不是反对 prevents hesitation from sounding like rejection. 只是想 introduces what you need before agreeing.

closing.meaning: Okay, let me know when you have thought it over.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, xiǎng hǎo le zài gàosù wǒ.

incomingNote: 那就这么定了？ asks whether the decision is settled. Explain what you still need before committing.

title: Ask for help in an unfamiliar situation

practice.meaning: I need time.
practice.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào shíjiān.

transfer.meaning: I need help.
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào bāngzhù.

scene: You are stuck on a task. Ask someone for help.
explanation: 我 means “I”. 需要 means “need”. Put what you need after 我需要.

closing.meaning: No problem, I will help you.
closing.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ lái bāng nǐ.

incomingNote: 需要帮助吗？ offers help. It reuses 需要 and 帮助; 吗 marks a yes/no question.

title: Ask for the wording or pronunciation you need

practice.meaning: How do you pronounce this?
practice.pinyin: Zhège zěnme dú?

transfer.meaning: How do you say this?
transfer.pinyin: Zhège zěnme shuō?

huahua.meaning: What would you like to ask?

scene: A text card reads “Thank you”. Ask how to say that phrase in Mandarin, rather than how to pronounce Chinese characters.
explanation: 怎么说 asks how to express a phrase. 怎么读 asks how to pronounce written Chinese.

closing.meaning: You can say: thank you.
closing.pinyin: Kěyǐ shuō, xièxiè nǐ.

incomingNote: 你想问什么？ asks what you would like to ask. Use the text card to explain which kind of help you need.

title: Recover when listening fails

practice.hanzi: 我没听清楚，可以写下来吗？
practice.meaning: I did not catch that. Could you write it down?
practice.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīng qīngchǔ, kěyǐ xiě xiàlái ma?

transfer.hanzi: 我没听清楚，可以再说一遍吗？
transfer.meaning: I did not catch that. Could you say it once more?
transfer.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīng qīngchǔ, kěyǐ zài shuō yí biàn ma?

scene: You missed a spoken sentence and cannot look at a screen right now. Ask to hear it again, rather than asking for a written version.
explanation: 没听清楚 means you did not catch what was said. 再说一遍 asks for another repetition; 写下来 asks for a written version.

closing.hanzi: 好，我再说一遍：明天上午十点见。
closing.meaning: Okay, I will repeat it: see you at ten tomorrow morning.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zài shuō yí biàn míng tiānshàng wǔshí diǎn jiàn.

incomingNote: 听清楚了吗？ asks whether you caught the words clearly. Your reply explains that you did not, then requests help.

title: Confirm before acting

prefix.meaning: links a description to a noun

practice.hanzi: 你的意思是，今天再来，对吗？
practice.meaning: You mean I should come back today, right?
practice.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsī shì, jīntiān zài lái, duì ma?

transfer.hanzi: 你的意思是，明天再来，对吗？
transfer.meaning: You mean I should come back tomorrow, right?
transfer.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsī shì, míngtiān zài lái, duì ma?

scene: You have been told to return tomorrow. Check that you understood the day correctly.
explanation: 你的意思是 introduces your interpretation. 对吗？ asks whether you understood correctly.

closing.meaning: Right, tomorrow.
closing.pinyin: Duì, shì míngtiān.

incomingNote: 明天再来 means “Come back tomorrow”. Keep the same day when you check your understanding.

title: Explain your priorities

practice.meaning: For me, exams matter more.
practice.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, kǎoshì gèng zhòngyào.

transfer.meaning: For me, communicating matters more.
transfer.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, jiāoliú gèng zhòngyào.

scene: You are comparing an exam course with conversation practice. Explain that communication is your priority.
explanation: 对我来说 marks your personal perspective. 更重要 says which of the two established choices matters more to you.

closing.meaning: Then let us practise communicating more.
closing.pinyin: Nà wǒmen jiù duō liànxí jiāoliú.

incomingNote: 你最看重什么？ asks what you value most. State the priority described in this practice situation.

title: Propose a better approach

practice.hanzi: 与其继续等，不如先弄清楚情况。
practice.meaning: Rather than keep waiting, we should first understand the situation.
practice.pinyin: Yǔqí jìxù děng, bùrú xiān nòng qīngchǔ qíngkuàng.

transfer.hanzi: 与其急着决定，不如先弄清楚情况。
transfer.meaning: Rather than rush to a decision, we should first understand the situation.
transfer.pinyin: Yǔqí jízhe juédìng, bùrú xiān nòng qīngchǔ qíngkuàng.

scene: Someone wants an immediate decision, but key information is missing. Propose understanding the situation before rushing to decide.
explanation: 与其 introduces the less desirable approach. 不如 introduces the better alternative you propose.

closing.hanzi: 好，我们先把情况了解清楚。
closing.meaning: Okay, let us understand the situation first.
closing.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen xiān bǎ qíngkuàng liǎojiě qīngchǔ.

incomingNote: 现在就决定吧？ suggests deciding now. Explain why you want to understand the situation first.
